The calendar

Complete today’s chapter to reveal tomorrow’s door. Earlier chapters remain replayable; future doors stay sealed unless the calendar date and prior completion both allow access.

See release strategy

One connected anthology

The stolen North Star

The hook

The Star-Keeper has vanished and the great advent mechanism has jammed. Its 24 doors now open into damaged tales. You are the temporary caretaker—because the qualified candidate clicked “remind me later.”

mysterycosy perildry humour

The structure

Each day has a cold open, four to six logic rooms, a short character scene and one piece of the larger mechanism. The finale recombines skills the player already understands rather than introducing a last-minute rulebook.

no grindinghint laddercontroller ready

Daily rhythm

Simple rules, deep combinations

Meet one rule

A safe room teaches a device through play, with no tutorial wall.

Twist it

The next rooms combine space, timing, weight, light or sound.

Tell a joke

A character reframes the problem without interrupting the player.

Pay it off

A final multi-stage room makes the player feel clever, not tested.

Caretaker console

Emergency keys

For accessibility, reviews, missed days and people who simply paid for the game and would like to play it.
